# axm docs prune

Prune stale docs lock entries

## When to use

Prune stale docs lock entries

## Usage

```bash
axm docs prune [flags]
```

## Arguments

None.

## Flags

| Name      | Type   | Required | Description                                                                      |
| --------- | ------ | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--scope` | choice | No       | Prune project (default) or user-level docs lock entries (choices: project, user) |

Global flags are documented on [Global flags](../global-flags).

## Examples

**Prune stale docs lock entries**

```bash
axm docs prune
```

## Requirements

None.

## Side effects

None.
